title: Introduce golden-route degradation detector and alert-fingerprint index
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: We see recurring noisy alerts from high-traffic tenant routes where short-lived token-latency spikes cause broad SLO churn. This PR introduces a lightweight golden-route degradation detector that treats a small set of customer-designated "golden" routes as canaries for systemic degradation and couples that signal to an alert-fingerprint index used to suppress or reclassify noisy alerts.

What this PR does: implements an in-memory sliding histogram + exponential dampener for per-token latency/cost traces on golden routes; a compact alert fingerprint index (time-windowed, LRU-backed) that maps correlated metric+trace signatures to fingerprint IDs; a routing policy that tags alerts from dependent routes with the golden-route fingerprint when correlation exceeds threshold; dashboard and alerts updates to visualize correlation scores and fingerprint prevalence.

Design notes: the detector runs as a sidecar plugin in the observability pipeline (small CPU footprint, bounded memory). We intentionally avoid heavy join queries at ingest; fingerprint correlations are calculated via hash-augmented reservoir samples and a lightweight cosine similarity on binned latency/cost vectors. The fingerprint index is exported for downstream incident tooling and linked to existing trace IDs for deep-dive.

Testing and rollout strategy: feature guarded behind "observability.golden_route_detector" feature flag. Step rollout: 1) enable in staging and run synthetic canary traffic for 48h; 2) enable read-only in prod for telemetry collection; 3) enable alert annotation + auto-suppress on a 10% tenant sample; 4) expand as confidence grows.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of detector and fingerprint index
- [x] Unit tests for histogram/reservoir logic and correlation heuristics
- [x] Integration test for alert annotation path
- [x] Dashboard panels and example alerts
- [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan
- [x] Release notes

Commits summary (high level): see commits section.

Changed areas (high level): core observability pipeline (detector), alert router, dashboards, a couple of SDK instrumentation helpers and tests.

Why this is safe: default mode is observation-only and memory bounded; correlation thresholds are conservative (0.8) and configurable. The change reduces alert noise by reclassifying alerts that match golden-route degradation fingerprints; it does not mute alerts without a matching fingerprint.

Related: linear ENG-6722 and ENG-6777, support ticket SUP-2123 for noisy tenant alerts.

release_notes: Adds a golden-route degradation detector and compact alert-fingerprint index. The feature is opt-in behind a feature flag and reduces noisy alerts by annotating and reclassifying alerts that correlate with golden-route degradations.
